name: capture_native_ui_scenario
description: Run selected-element press, increment/decrement scroll, AXValue text entry and bounded wait steps in one exact native app window. Returns ordered before/after captures and action/capture failures. Actions can change app data, network activity and persistent state; application state is left as-is and restoration is not attempted. native_ui_deadline_ms is the scenario deadline (omitted means 180000 ms, range 1..2147483647, next call). It does not raise the fixed 67108864-byte output allowance or the 180000 ms wait-step cap.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

max_nodes.description: Maximum accessibility nodes per capture; increase for large windows.

native_ui_deadline_ms.description: Deadline in milliseconds for this UI observation or scenario, including helper preparation and captures. Omitted means 180000. Integer from 1 to 2147483647. Applies on the next call. Does not raise the fixed 67108864-byte scenario output allowance or the 180000 ms cap on one wait step. A partial observation may already be retained when this deadline expires.
